description: Stop a running background task and all processes it started. Returns its final state (killed). The sandbox itself keeps running. Requires: token.

sandbox_id.description: Sandbox id as returned by create_sandbox / list_sandboxes, e.g. "sb_3f2a…".

task_id.description: Task id returned by run_code / exec_command with background: true.

name: kill_task
title: Stop a background task
